system.description: Armor Class: 7 Hit Dice: 1-4 (M-L) Move: 240' (80') Attacks: 1 attack (butt, bite, or kick, by species) Damage: 1d4, ld6, or 1d8 No. Appearing: 0 (3d10) Save As: Fl Morale: 5 Treasure Type: Nil Intelligence: 2 Alignment: Neutral XP Value: 10, 20, 35, or 75 Giant ants behave just like their smaller cousins. They wander all over the landscape, finding sources of ready food (grain warehouses, watering-holes, villages), communicate their finds to the nest, and set up a trail from the nest to the food and back.
